translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Jesús Gadara-yargi dule-niaburba-ichesur-nikad nudaksad
Jesús e-sapinganmala mata-dummad-gaka-obakar modapmalad, Gadara-neg-nugadse.
Jesús urgi-sii aidedgu, dule-gwensak-niaburba-nikad, neg-uangi Jesús dikasur daksa, abin abarmakalid.
A-dule neg-uan na e-negga imaksa-gudiid. Dule geg gaed, eskoro-dubginse-bakar geg egi edilleged.
Eskoro-dubgi e-nag, degi, e-argan edindamalan-inigwele, eskoro-dub ese itirid-daed. Degisoggu, dule geg-gae gudisunnad.
Dule-niaburba-nikad yala-imbaganba neg-uangi binnasur gordii, na dukin akwagi sarsodii oiboar daed, ar degi-osedod dabalid.
Jesússe nonigu, yokorgi sindigar Jesús-abin signonikid.
Jesúsga binnasur sogded: —¡Mer ibgwensur be an-sao, Jesús Bab-Dummad-Bur-Dummadid-E-Machi! Napira Bab-Dummad-nuggi be anga soge, ise-mesagwar an be imakosurye.
Weyob Jesúsga niaburba-nikad sogsa-gusad, ar ade Jesús ega sogsad: “Niaburba dulegi be maid be noe.”
Degi Jesús a-dulese egichialid: —¿Igi be nuga? Dule, abin-sogded: —Bukidarad an nuga, ar ade anmar niamar-ichesulid.
Degi niamar Jesúsgi gannar-gannar wilenagusad: —Mer dikasur anmar-barmidoye.
Deunni sinmar-bukidar yar-naba mas mananaid.
Niaburbamar Jesúsgi wilenagusad, ega sogdemalad: —Sinmar-bukwadse be anmar-barmid, ase be anmar-ouboge.
Jesús niaburbamar-onisgu, niaburbamar-barmisad sinmar-bukwadse. Niaburbamar sinmargi ubodapgu, sinmar-milibo yar-wereged-naba-bukwadi, mata-dummadse batenonigu, bela sinmar gundilegar burgwismalad.
Sin-edarbemalad dobguar duurmakdemalad, igarba nadapgu, degi, neggweburse nonimargu, bela aimarga sogdemalad, igi sinmar gusa. Dulemar degi-neg-gusad daknonimarsunnad.
Jesússe nonimargu, dakarmalad dule-nia-bukidar-nika-gudii-daed nugus, mola nued yoi-sii. A-dulemar, dobe itodmalad.
Dulemar daksamalad, dule-nia-nika-gudigusad igi nugusa, degi, sinmar igi mata-dummadse bela babatis burgwisa, amar, dulemar-daksasurmaladga bela sogdemalad, igi igargan gusa.
Gadara-dulemar Jesúsgi nue wilenagusad, ega sogdemalad: “We-yargi-be-gudiid be nae.”
Jesús ur-naidse nonigu, dule nia-nika-gudigusad, Jesúsgi wilenagusad, eba naegar.
Jesús ega sogded: —Anba be naosur. Be-negse bur be nae, be-gwenadganse. Amarga be sogna, igi Bab Dummad nue wile be-daksa, ibiga nabir be-nudaksa.
Dule-niaburba-nika-gudigusad nadsun, Decápolis-yargi neggweburmar-bukwadgi sunmakdii-gualid, igi Jesús wile e-dakedba e-nudaksa. Bela-dulemar geger dakmalad ibiyobi nabir nugusa.
Jairo-bunolo durgusad, degi, ome Jesús-mor-duku ebusgu, nugusad
Jesús gannar urgi mata-dummad-gaka-baidse obaksabargu, a-mata-gaka-naba dulemar-bukidar ese nonimalad.
Degi sii, Judiomar-onmaked-neg-daked-e-dummad-wargwen, Jairo-nugad, Jesússe nonikid. Jesús-dakargu, yokorgi sindigar e-asabin signonikid.
Degi Jesúsgi nue wilenagusad, ega sogded: —An-bunagwa burgwedani maid. Anba be dage, be-argangi an-bunagwa be ebudage, adi mer burgwegar, yog nuguar guegar.
Geb degi Jesús Jairoba nade-gusad. Dule-bukidar ali-ali na barmesnanai Jesúsba nade-gusmarmogad.
Dulemar-bukidar-nadapmalad-abargi ome-gwensak birga-ambe-gakabogus boni-nalur-nika-gudiid nadap-gusmogad.

A-ome nue wiles, na san-nunmaked abgadii ina-duledganse gusad. Aisaar nuguoeyob, inadurgan onodii, mani sabsur ukdii na san-ular gussoggu, mani bela ei bergussunnad, degisoggu wilearsunnad. Degite ome gwen bendaklessulid, aka-bur-bule ega bonigan burgumai-gualid.
Ome-bonigwar-gudiid, Jesús-nug bilear itoargu, emar-abargi Jesús-yarganba e-mor-duku ebugega nonikid.
Ar ade ome binsaded: “Unnila e-mor-dukubi wis an ebusale, gusbin-itole, ar yog an nuguar naoed.”
Ome Jesús-e-mor-duku ebusgu, e-boni yog nuguar naded. Ome magasaila na san itosad e-san nugusad.
Jesús e-burba-gangued sikwas egi node itossoggu, yog aibiris imaksad, dulemar-bukidar-bukwadse egisdesunnad: —¿Doa an-mor-duku ebusa?
E-sapingan, abin-sogded: —¿Ar sunna be wisguosi doa be-ebusa, dule-bukidar be-ebilis na muchub-muchub barmesnanaid be daksursi? Be wisguosurguoe doa be-ebusa.
Jesús nue-nuu e-dikarba-bukmalad-dakdegu, aminagusad, doa e-ebusa.
Ome na e-san-nugusad mag itossoggu, dobe-itogedba ise-wawanmakar Jesússe nonikid, asabin yokorgi sindigar ese signonikid, bela Jesúsga sogdesunnad, igi na san gudigusad.
Jesús omega sogdesunnad: —Omegwa, be nue an-bengussursoggu, be nugussun. Be gwage-bogidikidgi be-negse be nasun, degine, be-bonigan bela bei bergussun.
Amba Jesús omega sunmakgwichi, dulemar-Jairo-neggi-danimalad Jairoga sognonikid: “Be bunolo bato burgwis, mer be odurdaked-sailagi bar wilege bega be-bunolo nudakegar.”
Jesús deyob-dulemar-soge itosgu, bunolo-e-babga sogded: —Mer be bukib-binsao, unnila mer be an-benguo.
Jesús dulemar eba gwen naed imaksasulid, unnila Pedro, Santiago, agi Juan, Santiago-urba, amarbi eba-naed imaksad.
Jesús Jairo-negse modapgu, dulemar-dakdapid bela oimakbukwa, ise-nue-binnasur wilegar bobukwa.
Jesús neg-yaba dogdegu, amarga sogded: —¿Ibiga bemar oimakbukwa, ibiga bemar bobukwa? Bunolo burgwar maisulid, bunolo gabmaid.
Jesús-degi-sogsad dulemar bela abin alliarmalad, egi dododmalad. Jesús bela dulemar-bukwad-onisgu, unnila bunolo-e-bab, e-nan, degi, eba-nadapmaladbi dogega imaksad, bia bunolo maidse.
Jesús bunolo argangi gasgu, e-gayaba bunologa sogded: —Talita cumi. A sogleged: “Bunolo an bega soge, be gwisgu.”
Degi ega sogsagu, bunolo yog gwisgualid, geb degi yog nanaalid, ar ade bunolo yolabirga-ambe-gakabo nikad. Jesús bunolo-odulosad, dulemar geger dakdemalad.
Jesús ise-binnasur dulemar-bukwadga sogded: —Mer bipisaale aimar-baiganga bunolo-durgusad be daksamalad be sogmalo. Geb sogdebalid: —Masgi bunolo-ogunmarsun.
